name: Mandrill Mayhem
description: A Jumanji-themed launched wing coaster 20 m high reaching 72 km/h with one inversion, opened in 2023. Min 120cm.

name: Vampire
description: A suspended coaster 21 m high reaching 72 km/h, opened in 1990 and fitted with new floorless trains in 2002. Closed for maintenance on the Christmas 2026 dates. Min 110cm.

name: Rattlesnake
description: A wild mouse coaster 15 m high reaching 45 km/h, opened in 1998 and built partly below ground. Min 140cm.

name: Dragon's Fury
description: A spinning coaster in the Land of the Dragons, opened in 2004. Min 120cm.

name: Croc Drop
description: A 26 m drop tower with rotating gondolas, opened in 2021. Closed for maintenance on the Christmas 2026 dates. Min 130cm.

name: Blue Barnacle
description: A swinging pirate ship 11 m high in Shipwreck Coast, opened in 2021. Min 110cm.

name: Tiger Rock
description: A log flume with two drops, 15 m high, opened in 1987 as Dragon River and renamed Tiger Rock in 2018. Closed for maintenance on the Christmas 2026 dates. Min 120cm.

name: Barrel Bail Out
description: A spinning tub water ride in Shipwreck Coast, opened in 2022. Closed for maintenance on the Christmas 2026 dates. Min 90cm.

name: ZUFARI: Ride into Africa
description: An off-road safari truck ride of about 8 minutes through the zoo's animal reserves, opened in 2013. Closed for maintenance on the Christmas 2026 dates. Min 100cm.

name: The Gruffalo River Ride Adventure
description: A dark boat ride through the Gruffalo's story, opened in 2017. Children under 110 cm ride with an adult.

name: Room on the Broom - A Magical Journey
description: A magical walk-through journey based on the book by Julia Donaldson and Axel Scheffler, opened in 2019. Children under 110 cm go with an adult.

name: Tomb Blaster
description: An interactive shooter dark ride in the Forbidden Kingdom where riders aim laser guns at targets. It opened in 1987 and has had its current name since 2002. Children under 110 cm ride with an adult.

name: Chase's Mountain Mission
description: A junior family coaster in World of PAW Patrol, opened on 3 May 2026. Min 90cm.

name: Skye's Helicopter Heroes
description: An aerial ride in World of PAW Patrol, opened on 3 May 2026. Min 90cm.

name: Seastorm
description: A spinning galleon ride in Shipwreck Coast, opened in 1995 and refurbished in 2022. Closed for maintenance on the Christmas 2026 dates. Min 90cm.
